== HTML/CSS ==
- Dark page: body background #05070f, margin 0, flex center, min-height 100vh, overflow hidden.
- One 800x800 <canvas id="scene" width="800" height="800"> centered, with a thin 1px border rgba(0,229,255,0.25) and a subtle outer box-shadow glow (e.g. 0 0 40px rgba(0,229,255,0.15)).

== Config object (single `cfg` object, these exact concepts) ==
neuronCount: 5, growthSpeed: 2, maxDepth: 6, splitChance: 0.35, curvature: 0.35, maxBranchLength: 40, synapseDist: 40, synapseGlow: 12, pulseSpeed: 2, pulseFrequency: 3, pulseBrightness: 14, bgColor: '#05070f', branchColor: '#00e5ff', accentColor: '#d6ff00', synapseColor: '#ff2bd6', pulseColor: '#fff36a', plus function properties regenerate(), clearCanvas(), pauseResume().

== GUI setup (dat.gui) ==
Root gui (width 300). Folders:
- "Growth": neuronCount (1..8 step 1), growthSpeed (0.2..6), maxDepth (1..10 step 1), splitChance (0..1), curvature (0..1), maxBranchLength (10..120 step 1). Structural params (neuronCount, maxDepth, splitChance, curvature, maxBranchLength) call generate() onFinishChange so the network regrows.
- "Synapses": synapseDist (5..120), synapseGlow (0..30).
- "Pulses": pulseSpeed (0.2..6), pulseFrequency (0..12), pulseBrightness (0..30).
- "Visuals": addColor for bgColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor.
Root-level buttons: gui.add(cfg,'regenerate').name('Regenerate Network'), gui.add(cfg,'clearCanvas').name('Clear Canvas'), gui.add(cfg,'pauseResume').name('Pause / Resume'). Open all folders by default.

== Data model (lightweight arrays/objects only) ==
- somas: [{x,y,neuron}]
- segments: [{x1,y1,cx,cy,x2,y2,thick,depth,accent,neuron}] (quadratic curve pieces)
- tips (active growing ends): [{x,y,angle,depth,segLeft,neuron,thick,acc}]
- terminals (finished tips): [{id,x,y,neuron}]
- synapses: [{x1,y1,x2,y2,phase}]
- pulses: [{syn,t,dir,speed}]
- a Set of connected terminal-id pairs to prevent duplicate synapses.

== Neuron growth ==
generate(): reset all arrays/Sets; place cfg.neuronCount somas at random positions within ~90px of canvas center (400,400); each soma spawns 2-4 initial tips with random angles, depth 0, thickness 2.2-3.2, segLeft = 10 + random*cfg.maxBranchLength.
Growth runs step-by-step over frames (NOT instant): each animation frame, for every active tip, accumulate cfg.growthSpeed into tip.acc and while tip.acc>=1 perform one growth step and tip.acc-=1.
One growth step for a tip:
- angle += (Math.random()-0.5) * cfg.curvature * 0.9
- step length ~6px: nx = x + cos(angle)*6, ny = y + sin(angle)*6
- control point: midpoint of (x,y)-(nx,ny) offset perpendicular by (Math.random()-0.5)*cfg.curvature*14 (organic quadratic curve)
- push segment {x1:x,y1:y,cx,cy,x2:nx,y2:ny, thick: tip.thick*(0.92+Math.random()*0.16), depth, accent: Math.random()<0.18, neuron}
- update tip position; segLeft--
- random side branch: if Math.random()<0.03 && depth<cfg.maxDepth, spawn child tip at current pos, angle +/- (0.5..1.2 rad), depth+1, thick*0.8
- when segLeft<=0: if depth<cfg.maxDepth && Math.random()<cfg.splitChance -> spawn 2 child tips (angle +/- (0.4+random*0.5), depth+1, thick*0.75, fresh segLeft scaled down by depth); else the tip terminates: assign it a terminal id, push to terminals, run synapse check for it (below), remove tip from active list.
- Hard caps for performance: if segments.length>1200 or synapses.length>250, stop all growth (clear tips). Growth naturally stops when no active tips remain (stable size).

== Synapse detection ==
When a tip terminates (and also each growth step for still-active tips against existing terminals): for each terminal of a DIFFERENT neuron, if euclidean distance < cfg.synapseDist and the terminal-id pair is not already in the connected Set and synapses.length<250, add synapse {x1,y1,x2,y2, phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2} and record the pair key "minId_maxId" in the Set. Keep this O(tips x terminals) — small numbers, no spatial structures needed.

== Pulse animation ==

- Each frame: p.t += p.speed*dt; if p.t>=1: 10% chance to bounce (t=0, dir*=-1) else remove.
- Pulse position: lerp between synapse endpoints honoring dir (dir 1: from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2); dir -1 reversed). Smooth interpolation only, no physics.

== Rendering (every requestAnimationFrame; render even when paused so color tweaks show; only update simulation when not paused) ==
1. Fill canvas with cfg.bgColor.
2. Background glow: radial gradient centered (400,400), inner rgba from #101a3a (use hexToRgba helper, alpha ~0.55) to transparent at radius ~550.
3. Scanlines: pre-rendered offscreen 800x800 canvas with horizontal 1px lines rgba(0,229,255,0.08) every 3px; drawImage each frame with a slow vertical drift offset (offset = (time*8)%3) and globalAlpha 0.6.
4. Branches: for each segment, strokeStyle = seg.accent ? cfg.accentColor : cfg.branchColor; shadowColor same; shadowBlur 8; lineWidth = seg.thick; lineCap 'round'; path = moveTo(x1,y1) quadraticCurveTo(cx,cy,x2,y2); stroke. globalAlpha 0.9.
5. Somas: filled circle radius 5.5 at each soma, fillStyle cfg.branchColor, shadowColor cfg.branchColor, shadowBlur 18.
6. Synapses (brighter than branches): for each synapse, pulseFactor = 0.7+0.3*Math.sin(time*3+phase); draw a faint connecting line (strokeStyle cfg.synapseColor, globalAlpha 0.3, lineWidth 1, shadowBlur cfg.synapseGlow*pulseFactor) and glowing dots radius 2.5+1.5*pulseFactor at both endpoints (fillStyle cfg.synapseColor, shadowColor cfg.synapseColor, shadowBlur cfg.synapseGlow*pulseFactor).
7. Pulses (electric sparks): at interpolated position draw dot radius 2.2, fillStyle cfg.pulseColor, shadowColor cfg.pulseColor, shadowBlur cfg.pulseBrightness, plus 2 trailing dots at slightly earlier t values with decreasing alpha (0.5, 0.25) for a spark trail.
8. Grit: ~40 random 1px specks per frame, fillStyle rgba(255,255,255,0.05) or rgba(0,229,255,0.05), scattered randomly — cheap animated grain.
9. Vignette: pre-rendered offscreen 800x800 radial gradient (transparent center -> rgba(0,0,0,0.55) at edges), drawImage last.
Reset shadowBlur=0 and globalAlpha=1 between groups where needed. Clamp dt to max 0.05s. Include a small hexToRgba(hex, alpha) helper.

== Wiring ==
cfg.regenerate = generate; cfg.clearCanvas = () => { segments.length=0; synapses.length=0; pulses.length=0; tips.length=0; terminals.length=0; somas.length=0; connectedPairs.clear(); }; cfg.pauseResume toggles a `paused` boolean. Start: generate() then requestAnimationFrame loop with timestamp-based dt.
